description: One of the two contracts that declare a `Session`.

Its `Session` is the caller's view — an identity and when it began — and `pipe.events` declares a different shape under the same name. Neither is wrong: each spelling is right in its own scope, which is exactly the situation the folder layout exists to write down and the flat per-type layout exists to refuse.
When the session began, in the shared spelling rather than a private restatement of it.

types.name: Session
description: A running session, as the rpc caller sees it.

fields.name: started
description: When it began. An imported shape, so this file's import crosses folders.

ops.name: pipe.rpc.get
description: The session, restated. An op is here because a contract with none is a name rather than a contract; the fixture's subject is the types.
